title: Application Security Lab — Injection Detection and Remediation
problem: Demonstrate one complete application-security correction over an owned local target: define the trust boundary, reproduce a vulnerability, remediate it, and lock the repair with behavioral and static regression evidence.
constraints: Target is an owned/local in-memory SQLite fixture.
No third-party exploitation or penetration-testing claim.
The intentionally vulnerable implementation is retained only as a before-state witness.
demonstrated_capability: controlled SQL-injection reproduction in a local fixture
Bandit static-analysis comparison between vulnerable and remediated implementations

external_witness.claim: application-security-lab workflow run 1 passed behavioral before/after tests, security-report verification, Bandit scan of remediated code, expected finding in the intentional vulnerable fixture, and artifact upload

limits: No red-team or network exploitation witness.
Only one demonstrated vulnerability class so far.
